	set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_clinic_quote = { value = gdp_total multiply = 0.001 } }
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_CHI_brigade_clinics_funded_tt
		check_variable = { COLDWAR_CHI_clinic_quote > 0 }
		check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_CHI_clinic_quote compare = greater_than_or_equals }
	}
}
